storyInfo: Working together, the students brought the statue of Igor crashing down, smashing a gaping hole in the wall. With Pavlovich defeated, they broke through the blockade and charged out of Katorga.

attributes.content: Forward! Tear them to pieces!
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: No conserving ammo! Everyone gets a bonus when we win!
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Fire!
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: This will do a number, even on these nutjobs! Pin them behind their cover!
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: Instructor! Time to pull back!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Take the wounded! I'll cover you!
attributes.name: Dur-nar

attributes.content: They can't take any more! Focus fire on that Vulpo with the shield!
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: Svolach! How dare you use the boss's stash against us!
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B

attributes.content: Avenge Gromov!
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug C

attributes.content: The calls for vengeance swell like waves, as thugs rush forward like the tide...
Rosalind can't hold out much longer! We have to help!
attributes.name: Anxious Student

attributes.content: Stay hidden. She'll be fine. Everything is going according to plan.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: But they have more firepower than we thought. If they got supplies from outside, we—
attributes.name: Anxious Student

attributes.content: Calm down... believe in your comrades.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I've served under the greatest tactician across all the lands. We will get out of here.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: ...Yes, ma'am!
attributes.name: Anxious Student

attributes.content: Zima takes a deep breath as the tide approaches, following in hot pursuit of Rosalind's group.

Dur-nar puts up only symbolic resistance before turning and running away. Behind them, the thugs pursue like hungry manglerbeasts, squeezing into the narrow alley barely wide enough for two cars to pass each other.
They do not notice the viscous liquid beneath their feet, nor the unnaturally shut windows above their heads.
The brats are afraid! After them!
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: The Sixteen Warriors have reached the target location.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Sonya?
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Ready, on my mark.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: At the end of the alley, Dur-nar suddenly stops her fleeing steps.
She does not look back, only turning sideways and knocking her shield on the ground with a 'thump'.
Group One, Group Two, go!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The windows open at the same time, dropping burning torches and explosives onto the thugs with impressive precision.
Flames climb their flimsy clothing, and the alley is suddenly filled with screams of terror.
Circle them from the sides! Avoid the flames in the middle!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: It's our turn now!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Countless figures emerge from the shadows, from underneath the shattered windows, from behind the overflowing trash cans.
Wielding pipes, spanners, and assorted weapons confiscated from Gromov's stash, they charge at their former oppressors with a roar.
Some wear school uniforms of various degrees of refinement, others wear old cotton coats, but all are wearing the same 'uniform' now.
On all their chests, painted in oil pigment, is a prominent symbol—a clenched fist, once raised simply to survive, now tightened to break its chains.
Ura—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Angry fists meet the thugs attempting to flee the siege in the alley.
One by one, the erstwhile jailers fall to the angry prisoners they have berated and persecuted.
Zima walks over the weapons on the ground to the head of the formation, gazing at the fleeing backs of their foes.
Medics, care for the wounded. The rest of you, we push forward.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Instructor, Rosalind, take some time to catch your breath.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I'm fine, Sonya! Let me—
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Zima walks towards her with a smile that permits no question or doubt. She extends her fist.
After a moment of hesitation, Leto nods and lifts her right hand, knocking it firmly against the offered fist.
(Whispers) Good work, General Leto. See you later.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Follow me, comrades!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Victory is before us. Do not let your guard down—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Sonya, they're pulling back to their lines and firing.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Take cover and assess their firepower.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Yes, ma'am.
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: They have reserves, General! Our right flank is pinned down!
attributes.name: Brave Student

attributes.content: I'm coming to help!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: ...Huh?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I'm going back out there once the bleeding is stanched, and I won't let anybody stop me.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Don't force it, Leto.
It's just a few scratches... hey!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Gummy?! What are you doing—
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Shh! Don't let Zima hear you, it'll distract her.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I wanted to help, so I asked Lyudmila to bring me along.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: She even got some people to help us out.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Lyudmila? She's here too?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: A group appeared ahead.

It is as though they just crawled out from underground; few in number, they nevertheless charge at the thugs on the right flank without hesitation, and soon their greasy clothes are stained with blood.
You're mine, svolotsch!
attributes.name: Ursine Worker

attributes.content: Ura—
attributes.name: Ursine Citizens

attributes.content: We are not the only ones fighting against Pavlovich and oppression...
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Explosion? From behind enemy lines... must be the Unbound.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Antosha and his comrades are bleeding! Forward, friends!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The boys can't hold them! We need to fall back!
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug D

attributes.content: Shit, shit, shit! That's their 'support'? A few shots and a fart?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Hui! Ten days ago those nobles were fighting each other to kiss my boots! How did it come to this?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: It's time to go, magistrate!
attributes.name: Security Team Captain

attributes.content: We'll be taken prisoner if we stay!
attributes.name: Security Team Captain

attributes.content: Set a fire and go up the walls.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: The duke, no, Ursus will save me. I must fight to the bitter end.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: I will take these zasranets down with me, if I have to!
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: I made a round. It looks like the rest of them have retreated up the wall.
attributes.name: Brave Student

attributes.content: I'm back, Sonya! We've brought the explosives from behind. This is the right occasion for it.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: But the walls are tough, and we need to put out the fire and collect the explosives that they didn't remove.
attributes.name: Cautious Student

attributes.content: It'll take a lot of time...
attributes.name: Brave Student

attributes.content: We'll put out the fire first, then worry about the rest. Watch me—
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: ...Sonya?
attributes.name: Botani

attributes.content: Hah.... hah....
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Wh-Why don't you come in?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Sir... I understand your resolve.
attributes.name: Security Team Captain

attributes.content: But the walls are tough, and they haven't gained entry.
attributes.name: Security Team Captain

attributes.content: Can you put down the match? At least don't point it at the fuse—
attributes.name: Security Team Captain

attributes.content: Never!
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: ...What about the people that Captain brought?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: They seem to be struggling. We have not heard from them.
attributes.name: Security Team Captain

attributes.content: Sir, we cannot wait any longer! Hit that comm button and call in fire support!
attributes.name: Security Team Captain

attributes.content: No! What do you know?! I... I can't end up like that. I'd rather—
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: What's this sound? What are they doing?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Where are you going, Sonya? Come back!
attributes.name: Cautious Student

attributes.content: That's where the statue of Igor is, but the fire hasn't—
attributes.name: Brave Student

attributes.content: The swing of the massive hamaxe shatters the ground, sending burning grease and debris flying with the shockwave, and brutally ejecting the air itself from the area.
Denied oxygen, the flames are stemmed for a moment, before being quenched by the stirring dust.
I see...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: She steps forward and puts her boot on the ash where flames had burned a moment ago.
One strike, two strikes... sparks fall upon her hair and shoulders, as she continues to slam the burning earth, as though trying to forge a path where none existed.
Maybe toppling the statue in the direction of the wall will bash the gate open...
attributes.name: Cautious Student

attributes.content: People start to gather behind her, following her to the end of this flame-forged path—
The statue of Igor Velikiy stands next to the gate of the quarantine zone, gazing down at the last corner of Grypherburg, and at the bearer of the hamaxe.
The young leader walks toward the thousand-year-old giant, whose stony head wears a golden crown of sunlight, the emperor admiring the centuries of creation and suffering that he began.
She clutches her hamaxe. Every breath she takes seems to be the roaring furnace...
Hrrah—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: She raises her arm, for the voices trapped in her throat, and a gushing crack appears in the marble pedestal.
Follow Sonya!
attributes.name: Brave Student

attributes.content: Smash it, topple it! Grypherburg lies before us!
attributes.name: Brave Student

attributes.content: Here I come!
attributes.name: Resolute Student

attributes.content: She brings the hamaxe down again, for those dreams frozen in the winter night. Cobweb-like cracks spread through the empire's foundation, and the illusion of grandeur begins to wail.
Look at the cracks! It's buckling!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Don't just stand there, Fedya! Give us a hand!
attributes.name: Resolute Student

attributes.content: He peers up at the statue, once awe-inspiring, now trembling and teetering, his heart trembling along with the sound of every hit.
He cannot help but put his hand on the statue too. He hears the cries of young people all around him, feels the warmth of their shoulders rubbing against his.
Ura—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Magistrate!
attributes.name: Security Team Captain

attributes.content: Gosudar-batyushka—
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Igor's pieces come thundering down on his head as he mutters his last words.
The dust has yet to settle. A bright ray of light shines in.
Someone's running! More Sixteen Warriors ahead!
attributes.name: Student's Voice

attributes.content: Get them! Make them pay for their crimes!
attributes.name: Student's Voice

attributes.content: For Ursus!
attributes.name: Student's Voice

attributes.content: Igor's sword falls upon the wall, the authority wrought from stone shattered to pieces.
Igor's fist smashes the shackles. One figure climbs over the ruins, then a dozen, a hundred...
Zima's speech last night echoes in their minds.
...They told us to be ordinary.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Did they tell you that you would have bread and butter if you cut out your tongue?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Did they tell you that you would have a pardon if you shattered your kneecaps?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Did they tell you to polish your plaques and medals with your comrades' blood?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: How easy it would be to enter the dustbin of history, the trampled weeds that feed the soil...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: But no, we say.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: We chose kindness and honesty. We chose to brave the storm and suffering, because we are protecting ourselves, protecting everyone who deserves a future.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Once more unto the breach, dear friends, once more—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: For all the children of Ursus who will not kneel!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The red sweeps the earth like lava breaking through a dam.
The Ursine students burst forth from the pale, frozen soil.
I, I was the only one who made it out alive. Everyone else—
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug

attributes.content: (Sobs)
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug

attributes.content: That's the fourth one to describe the battle... why do they all sound the same?
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: Don't expect too much of Pavlovich's thugs. I think the captain's soldiers will be more useful.
attributes.name: Thinking Noble

attributes.content: Keep your emotions in check, sir. The committee needs more details.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Captain Chicherin has... fallen honorably. However, you say you are aware of the Captain's exploits in battle?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug

attributes.content: They, they killed almost all of the traitors, but most of them died in the explosion and the collapse—
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug

attributes.content: Liar!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: You didn't see anything that happened!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: ...Police, remove the child from the room.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: We've done an inventory check, General. We need to leave soon.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: ...How many casualties this time?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Medic team's still counting... not everyone made it.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: What about the Unbound?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Sonya. Rosalind.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Antosha?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Where are the others?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: We ran into a company of Ursus Guards while assaulting their rear.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Take this and press it against your chest. You'll be fine.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Mm...
attributes.name: Resolute Girl

attributes.content: Is it so late already, Matvey... it's dark...
attributes.name: Resolute Girl

attributes.content: The cold winter wind blows past, freezing the mud on her young face.
Yeah.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: They're well-equipped. We can't keep this up. Antosha—
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Antosha! Come back!
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Antosha charges forward, an Originium bomb in his arms. A bolt whistles past, and his left leg buckles, causing him to fall in the mud.
Almost—
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Footsteps approach like the beating of drums. Before he can react, a firm hand has snatched the Originium bomb from him.
Remember, Antosha?
attributes.name: Yura

attributes.content: I'm the nimblest amongst us.
attributes.name: Yura

attributes.content: Raise your weapons, svoloch! You will not kill freedom—
attributes.name: Yura

attributes.content: The Unbounded defeated them all...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Then, Matvey—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: No... no...
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: We're alive because of him. Because of all of you...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I'll find him and the others before we leave and say a proper goodbye, Antosha. I—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: No. Say no more.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: There is one more thing that you must do.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: You must defeat me.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: What?!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: You killed Pavlovich in order to walk out those gates.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Because you knew he was guilty, the persecutor of all who dwelled within Katorga...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Then why didn't you see the crimes of Pavalo, the crimes of the Ursine nobility?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: People like him, the nobles who are even worse, and this 'Emperor' Fyodor, all throw their weight about in this miserable hole.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: They watch as common folk bleed... they live off the rot, not a worry on their minds.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Think about our magistrate beneath the rubble. His pathetic life finally gave back to the oppressed at the moment of his death.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Their destruction brings the answer I seek, the total destruction of Ursus.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: You're judging everybody, justifying execution by their status.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Wrecking things is just a means to an end. Sometimes it can be useful, but it's pointless if it doesn't unite people.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: This again, this talk of flexibility, of taking stock of the situation...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Today, you leave them, their corrupt thoughts and methods to linger. Tomorrow, their 'better life' will claim your friends, and your successors.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: And you think death and destruction can get rid of the corrupt thoughts, and wipe out all injustice overnight?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: For the sake of a prophecy that hasn't even come to pass, we're not to unite and protect ourselves, but instead send our pure hearts to face the guns and warships of Ursus?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Enough talk, Sonya.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Since when did you pick up lecturing... we shall fight.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: You're hurt really bad.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Pave the path to your new order with my dead body.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: No.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Do you really think this is how you make your dreams come true...?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Or do you just want a poetic death because you saw your friends die?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I know how hard it is to be the only one left... but Antosha—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You're always talking up the value of destruction. You think that if I kill you, it will lay the foundation for some kind of future.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: And I'm not about to go along with that stupid idea. Taking a life doesn't add anything to a dream.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I have to go find my comrades...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Wait, Sonya, don't go—
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: ...Stop!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Do you think you're the only one who mourns the Unbound?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: No!
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Don't hurt them any more...
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Enough is enough.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Your dreams, and maybe even you yourself...
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: It's all the meaning of their sacrifice.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: That taste of rusty iron again. It is the second time that he has tasted such regret today.
What are you doing? Let me in!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Rosalind? Why...
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: This was the fastest way.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: We also needed time to bury our friends.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Ukusik...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Antosha! I'm here!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: You're bleeding! I'll wrap you up...
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: You don't know yet...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Know what?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: I woke up in Sonya's camp. They said Matvey brought me here last night.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Do you still have the letters?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Your Majesty! Your Imperial Majesty!
attributes.name: Anxious Noble

attributes.content: You must have suffered such a fright! We summoned the Imperial Guard as soon as we heard—
attributes.name: Anxious Noble

attributes.content: Really? To do what?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: To purge the traitors, of course!
attributes.name: Anxious Noble

attributes.content: Traitors, you say. Which traitors?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: You mean...?
attributes.name: Anxious Noble

attributes.content: Your Imperial Majesty!
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Witte?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: We can discuss at the palace.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: A car is waiting for Your Majesty.
attributes.name: Attendant

attributes.content: Fyodor can see the red velvet in the black car parked a short distance away, even seems to smell the familiar aroma.
He pauses, then keeps walking.
Tell me, Witte.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Is that fire the culmination of all that we achieved over the last twenty years?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: How did it come to this...?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Chairman, we can't let the people see His Imperial Majesty like this!
attributes.name: Attendant

attributes.content: Let him go.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: It is his wish...
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Fyodor has lived in this city for decades. Now, for the first time, he walks its streets on his own two feet.
The snow falls upon him, equally cold in the ruins as it is in the palace.
